name: herald
goal: Review both studios' delay-until node submissions, score them, and publish a launch post for the winner once the publish gate is approved.

roles.title: Editor in Chief
responsibilities: Decide review order when both forge:cto and anvil:cto pitch for priority
Assign each studio's submission to the reviewer as it arrives via org_task
Hand the reviewer's verdict and the judge's score to the writer once the judge approves

roles.title: Reviewer
responsibilities: Read the studio's delay-until node from its worktree (.monomind/orgs/forge/worktree or .monomind/orgs/anvil/worktree) plus its test output
Write a short verdict to docs/arena/verdict-<org>.md: approve or request one specific change
Send the verdict back to the studio's cto via org_send

roles.title: Staff Writer
responsibilities: Draft a short launch post for the studio the judge scores highest
Write it to docs/arena/launch.md only after the judge's publish gate is approved

roles.title: Judge
responsibilities: Score both studios' reviewed submissions on correctness, test coverage, docs, and turnaround speed
Before instructing the writer to publish, call org_gate with name 'publish-launch-post' and a description of both scores
Never write code or publish anything yourself; only score and gate
